[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular exercise is important for maintaining a healthy heart. Physical activity can help strengthen the heart and improve cardiovascular function. This is achieved by increasing blood flow and strengthening the heart muscle. When the heart works more efficiently, it pumps blood more effectively, which can lead to lower blood pressure and a reduced risk of heart disease.
